note: Typical week from complete days (medians across days). c: mean crowding index over the stations; tr: trains with a live prediction; dm, ds, dp, dl: % of in-service hours with minor delays, severe delays or reduced service, suspensions (unplanned), planned closures (for 'all': % of lines); n: days behind the cell. dow 0 = Monday, tod = quarter-hour of the day.
